# opencode

> Python SDK for the Opencode API, version 0.0.1. Install with `pip install opencode` and import `opencode`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com//blob/main/README.md): installation, usage, async client, retries, timeouts
- [api.md](https://github.com//blob/main/api.md): every resource, method and type
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com//blob/main/src/opencode/_agent/SKILL.md): agent skill with tested examples
